title: Investigating the Capabilities and Limitations of Machine Learning for Identifying Bias in English Language Data with Information and Heritage Professionals

bias_targets.methodology: Training supervised text classification models (using Random Forests, Conditional Random Fields, and Support Vector Machines) to identify gendered and gender-biased language (such as gendered pronouns, stereotypes, and omissions) in archival catalog metadata, followed by quantitative evaluation (Precision, Recall, F1) and a qualitative workshop evaluation with domain experts (information and heritage professionals).
